local_checks.invariant: Work done on a fetched page after the 10 s fetch timeout must be bounded roughly linearly in the 2 MB page, because it runs on the single bot event loop.
local_checks.result: Candidate: cleanLine (recipe.ts:30-45) runs /<(script|style)[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi over the FULL uncapped JSON-LD string before the 200-char cap (line 44). For a string made of repeated '<style' with no closing tag, every start position scans to the end of the string (quadratic). structured() maps cleanLine over every recipeIngredient entry before slice(0, MAX_LINES) (130) and accepts JSON-LD blocks up to 500,000 chars (114); if all lines clean to empty it continues to the next block (131), so up to ~4 such blocks fit in the 2 MB page. No timeout covers this (safe-fetch timer is cleared at 238-239). Runtime magnitude not measured: execution was not permitted.
